'''Yellow-rated constable''' was one of the ranks of the [[Sullustan Constable Brigade]], the [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement branch]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust's]] rulers, the [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]]. As with [[orange-rated constable]]s, yellow-rated constables were patrol officers who were more experienced than [[Infrared-rated constable|infrared-]] and [[red-rated constable]]s. Like the other eight ranks of the organizations, yellow-rated constable shared its name with a [[Color/Legends|color]] of the light spectrum.<ref name="Strongholds">''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The rank of yellow-rated constable was mentioned in the [[2015]] ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying]]'' sourcebook ''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]'', which was published by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] as part of the [[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion (roleplaying game)|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'']] [[roleplaying game]].<ref name="Strongholds" />
